outcome: Cesarean section rates among low-risk pregnancies
cohort: 263 rural hospitals providing obstetric care in 9 US states
finding: Rural hospitals employing only family physicians had lower cesarean rates among low-risk pregnancies compared to hospitals employing obstetricians.
mod_finding: A 10% higher proportion of obstetricians employed was associated with a 4.6% higher low-risk cesarean rate in hospitals with both obstetricians and family physicians.
